item.title: Federal funds barred from buying test strips, raising overdose concerns
item.description: Drug addiction groups are alarmed after Trump officials said federal grants cannot be used to distribute test strips to drug users, which help prevent overdoses.

item.title: Data centers become bipartisan issue influencing voter choices
item.description: Wisconsin Democratic candidate Francesca Hong and Ohio Republican hopeful Vivek Ramaswamy both called for moratoriums on data centers.

item.title: Senate confirms Todd Blanche as attorney general in narrow vote
item.description: The Senate narrowly confirmed Todd Blanche as U.S. attorney general early Saturday, elevating President Trump's former personal lawyer to lead the department.

item.title: Private prison firms report $1.4 billion revenue amid rising immigration detentions
item.description: The figure excludes $1.6 billion in net proceeds CoreCivic earned from selling four facilities to the Department of Homeland Security.
